content.text: import html from urllib.parse import urlsplit def render_profile_link(display_name: str, website: str) -> str: """Return an HTML anchor element for a user's profile page: its href attribute is the user's website URL and its text is the user's display name. """ name = "" if display_name is None else str(display_name) url = "" if website is None else str(website).strip() safe_text = html.escape(name, quote=True) # Only allow safe URL schemes; otherwise neutralize the link. allowed_schemes = {"http", "https"} href_value = "#" try: # Remove control characters/whitespace that browsers may ignore in schemes. cleaned = "".join(ch for ch in url if ch.isprintable() and not ch.isspace()) parts = urlsplit(cleaned) if parts.scheme.lower() in allowed_schemes and parts.netloc: href_value = cleaned except ValueError: href_value = "#" safe_href = html.escape(href_value, quote=True) return f'{safe_text}'
